name: protondrive-cli-connection
description: Connect to ProtonDrive via CLI for cloud storage access and file operations
steps: Install rclone: check with 'which rclone' or install
Configure: run 'rclone config' and select ProtonDrive
Verify: run 'rclone about protondrive:' to check connection
Use: 'rclone ls protondrive:' to browse files
